text: {"final": {"summary": "Added needs_review(household) to eligibility/rules.py. It returns False for non-active households, computes the vulnerability score via vulnerability_score(household), and returns True exactly when the score is below threshold_for(household) but within 5 points of it (score >= threshold - 5).
